iteratools-api v1.0.0

- Initial release of the IteraTools pay-per-use API skill.
- Offers access to 77+ tools, including web scraping, image and video generation, TTS, code execution, WhatsApp messaging, and more.
- No subscription required; pay per API call with clear USDC pricing.
- Provides detailed usage documentation, example curl commands, and error handling guidelines.
- Tools organized by category for easy discovery and reference.
